$comment: German localizations for Discord application-command metadata (NetCord JsonLocalizationsProvider; wired in Program.cs). Keys under 'commands' are the canonical English command names; 'parameters' keys are the canonical option names (snake_case). Command NAMES stay English in every locale — descriptions, option names/descriptions and enum choices are localized. /hoshi-say is currently the only application command, and keeps its original German wording (formerly the canonical text) byte-identically. A key here for a command that no longer exists is silently ignored (no test, no startup failure), so orphans must be removed by hand along with their command.

hoshi-say.description: Lass Hoshi eine Nachricht in diesen Kanal schreiben (nur mit der berechtigten Rolle)
